messages:
meera: heads-up — I want to recalibrate Q2 prioritization tomorrow. a few customer asks bumped our effort estimates and the impact assumptions feel optimistic.
alex: totally. can we run a short pass to normalize scores across infra vs platform bets?
jordan: +1. the Dedicated capacity tweaks look high-impact but cost-heavy. we should separate adoption vs revenue impact.
lina: quick note — enterprise VPC isolation request from AcmeCorp should get high confidence (they committed $$) but medium reach.
kai: propose using two lenses: customer-obligations (contracts) and product-leverage (opens up new segments). then map R/I/E per lens.
meera: that sounds good. sample re-score for the VPC isolation request (loan-shown):

```
feature: enterprise vpc isolation
reach: 3k active seats
impact: 8 (enterprise win probability)
confidence: 0.7
effort: 13 engineer-weeks
RICE: (8*3000*0.7)/13 ≈ 1292
``` 

meera: but that raw RICE is misleading because reach units differ from other initiatives (embeddings infra uses 100k-request units). we need normalization.
alex: suggestion: convert reach into percentile within bucket (customer-obligations, platform, infra). compute RICE using percentile * impact * confidence / effort.
jordan: if we do percentiles we lose absolute revenue signal. maybe weight reach by expected ARR too — different axis.
lina: can we add a mandatory field for "contracted ARR" when it's customer-driven? then the score formula can be hybrid: ARR-weighted RICE for contracts, percentile-RICE for platform bets.
pm-bot: reminder — add your updated scores to the Q2-prioritization doc by EOD so PMs can run the matrix tomorrow.
kai: operational ask: let's also tag items with rollout complexity (canary, db-migration, infra-change) so engineering sequencing is easier.
meera: agreed. plan for tomorrow: 10:30 sync, 20m score harmonization, 10m sequencing. please pre-fill the new ARR and rollout tags. thanks :thumbsup:
alex: will do. bringing a short script to convert reach->percentile.
jordan: i'll bring conservative ARR estimates for the big contracts.
lina: i'll update the doc with proposed rollout tags.
meera: cool. see you all.
